name: Merzouga
blurb: Posts about Merzouga focus primarily on desert landscapes, camel rides, and dune scenery in the Erg Chebbi region. Visitors note that reaching the area requires a long drive.

positive: Amazing desert camp experience and camel rides

Intrepid traveller and our foreign correspondent Dr Mary Anne Whiting (Wing Commander Retired) takes us to the Moroccan desert experience of Merzouga, Tangier and Timbuktu. And watches the sun set amongst the sand dunes, after an evening camel-ride
player.captivate.fm/episode/5b09...

Ever wonder why you need a sleeping bag in the Sahara? Morocco's Erg Chebbi drops 40°F between day and night. Turns out sand is terrible at holding heat – kind of like your ex at holding conversations. The physics behind desert temperature swings might surprise you.

So much to see.  But for me, the highlight so far was seeing the sunset in the Sahara after a camel ride.  If you can get down to Merzouga and stay in a desert camp, it is amazing.  It is a *long* drive though.
